headline: LPG price rises by Tk 70; 12kg cylinder now Tk 1,598 for August
summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the retail price of LPG cylinders of various sizes, including autogas.
details: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the retail price of a 12kg liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinder by Tk 70, bringing the price to Tk 1,598 for August.
The revised price for privately marketed LPG will take effect from 6:00pm today and will remain valid until further notice.
This adjustment represents a 4.6 percent increase from July's price of Tk 1,528, following a sharp reduction of Tk 357 in the previous month.
BERC stated that the price revision was based on its monthly pricing mechanism, accounting for changes in international LPG prices, shipping costs, exchange rates, and import-related expenses.
Prices for other cylinder sizes have also been revised: a 5.5kg cylinder will now cost Tk 732, and a 15kg cylinder will be priced at Tk 1,997.
The price of autogas, used in vehicles, has also increased to Tk 73.67 per litre from Tk 70.40 per litre last month.
BERC has warned LPG operators, distributors, and retailers against charging more than the approved prices, warning of legal action for violators.
caption:
LPG prices are going up again. A 12kg cylinder will now cost Tk 1,598 starting tonight.

The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the retail price of a 12kg liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinder by Tk 70, bringing the price to Tk 1,598 for August.

The revised price for privately marketed LPG will take effect from 6:00pm today and will remain valid until further notice.

This adjustment represents a 4.6 percent increase from July's price of Tk 1,528, following a sharp reduction of Tk 357 in the previous month.

BERC stated that the price revision was based on its monthly pricing mechanism, accounting for changes in international LPG prices, shipping costs, exchange rates, and import-related expenses.

Prices for other cylinder sizes have also been revised: a 5.5kg cylinder will now cost Tk 732, and a 15kg cylinder will be priced at Tk 1,997.

The price of autogas, used in vehicles, has also increased to Tk 73.67 per litre from Tk 70.40 per litre last month.

BERC has warned LPG operators, distributors, and retailers against charging more than the approved prices, warning of legal action for violators.

headline_marked: Tk 57 lakh looted from bKash staff [[Armed robbers hit bus on Teknaf highway]]
headline: Tk 57 lakh looted from bKash staff Armed robbers hit bus on Teknaf highway
summary: Masked attackers used a nail-studded log to stop a Palki Paribahan bus, stabbing and assaulting three sales representatives.
details: Armed robbers intercepted a Palki Paribahan bus on the Cox's Bazar-Teknaf highway today, looting Tk 57 lakh in cash from three bKash sales representatives.
The incident occurred around 1:45 pm in the Dumdumia area of Teknaf upazila. Attackers used a large nail-studded log to block the highway and force the bus to stop.
Once stopped, the masked gunmen held passengers at gunpoint and searched the vehicle. Three bKash employees—Arman (24), Sakib (21), and Ekram (22)—were targeted.

Arman was stabbed during the attempt to resist, while Sakib and Ekram were assaulted. The cash had been withdrawn from the Teknaf branch of Shimanto Bank for delivery to agents in Hnila and Whykong unions.
The robbers fled toward the surrounding hills after the heist. Local residents suspect the gang may include both locals and Rohingyas.
A joint operation by the police, Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB), and the Coast Guard has been launched to identify the robbers' hideouts in the hills and recover the money.
